description: Check the form of a BIC, the Business Identifier Code (ISO 9362, commonly called a SWIFT code) of a bank or business. Send bic (8 or 11 characters) or bics (up to 200). Get back whether the form is right, the parts (institution code, country, location, branch), whether the country code is an ISO 3166-1 country, the 8 and 11 character forms, and whether the location code marks a test BIC or one not connected to the SWIFT network. It does not say which bank it is or that the code is in use. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/swift-bic-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

bic.description: One BIC, 8 or 11 characters. Spaces and hyphens are ignored; case does not matter.

bics.description: Up to 200 BICs to check in one call.
